base_roster_rules.body_material: elemental/cosmic completion instead of ordinary human skin completion
base_roster_rules.male_female: same soul/personality/moves/animation set; different visual presentation only
base_roster_rules.puppet_masks: reserved for Yin-controlled Black Puppet and Yang-controlled White Puppet story variants

ember-vale.name: Ember Vale
ember-vale.material_language: Elemental flame/heat body with charred ceramic/obsidian structure, thermal seams, furnace core and ignition gauntlets; human facial structure without ordinary human skin completion.
ember-vale.prismatic_expression: Six Essence colors appear as secondary ignition states while combustion remains the movement source.

rook-ironside.name: Rook Ironside
rook-ironside.material_language: Elemental stone/earth/forged-plate body with tectonic seams and shock-ring joints; human facial structure carved/formed from the element rather than ordinary skin.
rook-ironside.prismatic_expression: Other essences become material states—molten plate, conductive stone, cryo-strata, gravity compression, phase armor—while movement remains mass.

juno-spark.name: Juno Spark
juno-spark.material_language: Elemental electricity/electromagnetic body with conductive structures, polarity rails and current channels; human facial structure formed from luminous current, not shuffled human skin.
juno-spark.prismatic_expression: Each Essence changes acceleration medium while Juno still reads as speed/current first.

kaia-windrow.name: Kaia Windrow
kaia-windrow.material_language: Elemental wind/air/pressure humanoid with human facial structure formed from flowing green currents and pressure surfaces rather than ordinary skin.
kaia-windrow.prismatic_expression: Canonical prismatic story form: wind remains the binding medium carrying the six other Essences.

nix-calder.name: Nix Calder
nix-calder.material_language: Elemental ice/crystal humanoid with human facial structure sculpted from blue cryolattice material rather than ordinary skin.
nix-calder.prismatic_expression: Other essences become construction materials inside Nix's lattice language.

orion-vell.name: Orion Vell
orion-vell.material_language: Elemental gravity/cosmic humanoid with human facial structure formed from indigo cosmic material, orbit nodes and gravity surfaces rather than ordinary skin.
orion-vell.prismatic_expression: Six spectral nodes may orbit Orion; gravity remains the core language.

vesper-nyx.name: Vesper Nyx
vesper-nyx.material_language: Elemental void/phase humanoid with human facial structure formed from violet spatial material, negative space and ghost offsets rather than ordinary skin.
vesper-nyx.prismatic_expression: Each phase echo may carry a different Essence color while phase/void remains primary.

yin.name: Yin
yin.material_language: Black elemental/cosmic being with readable human facial structure but no ordinary human skin; a small white seed must remain visible.
yin.prismatic_expression: Not a Prismatic Gray unlock form; Yin is a cosmic endpoint unlocked after seven Gray routes.

yang.name: Yang
yang.material_language: White elemental/cosmic being with readable human facial structure but no ordinary human skin; a small black seed must remain visible.
yang.prismatic_expression: Not a Prismatic Gray form; Yang is a cosmic endpoint unlocked after seven Gray routes.
